properties.name: camel.component.jsonata.allow-template-from-header
properties.description: Whether the endpoints take the JSONata expression from the CamelJsonataResourceUri header, when the header is set, instead of from their resource. It is the default of the allowTemplateFromHeader option of each endpoint. Enable it only when the header comes from a trusted source.

properties.name: camel.component.jsonata.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.jsonata.content-cache
properties.description: Whether the endpoints keep the content of their resource in memory after the first load, instead of reading it again for each exchange. It is the default of the contentCache option of each endpoint.

properties.name: camel.component.jsonata.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the jsonata component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.jsonata.frame-binding
properties.description: A JsonataFrameBinding that binds custom functions and variables to the Jsonata.Frame of each evaluation. It is used by the endpoints that do not set their own frameBinding option. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.jsonata.JsonataFrameBinding type.

properties.name: camel.component.jsonata.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
